name: San Luis Rey
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A San Diego County AVA inside the South Coast AVA, stretching from the coast at Oceanside inland to the Merriam Mountains.
